decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and drawing cards to maintain card advantage. It utilizes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful Planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to control the pace of the game. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Subtlety for extra utility and versatility. By consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan and answering their threats, the UW Control deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents until it can secure a win condition.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with flicker effects to maximize value and disrupt opponents. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck can repeatedly blink key creatures to generate advantage and put pressure on the opponent. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the opponent's resources while powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Emperor of Bones end games quickly. The mana base allows for consistent color access and the inclusion of Dreams of Steel and Oil provides additional value and flexibility in gameplay.

The deck focuses on aggressively blinking creatures in and out of the battlefield to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. By combining creatures with impactful enters-the-battlefield effects with cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can continuously generate value and outpace the opponent. This strategy allows the deck to both apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy, making it a versatile and powerful archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play using reanimation spells like Persist and Unearth. By combining card draw, discard effects, and efficient removal spells, the goal is to set up a game-winning combo using creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Blood Moon and Field of Ruin to disrupt opponents and maintain control of the board. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively utilize cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage to the opponent quickly. By combining these creatures with aggressive spells like Lightning Bolt and Leyline of the Guildpact, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain control of the battlefield.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Territorial Kavu, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It also includes disruptive spells like Stubborn Denial and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The deck also has a strong mana base with fetch lands and Leyline of the Guildpact to support its 4-5 color aggro strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding provide additional synergy and ways to increase pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with quick and aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds additional threats and versatility to the deck. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Arena of Glory to provide extra advantage and disruption. Overall, this deck aims to apply consistent pressure and finish the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combination of Broodscale and Bloodchief creatures with powerful support cards to create a disruptive and aggressive strategy. The deck aims to generate advantage through efficient creature plays and disruption spells, while also using cards like Ancient Stirrings and Ugin's Labyrinth for consistency and control. By combining these elements, the deck can overwhelm opponents with strong creatures and versatile spells, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The main concept of this Aggro - Affinity deck is to quickly play low-cost artifact creatures like Memnite and Ornithopter, along with supporting cards like Cranial Plating and Urza's Saga, to swarm the opponent with a fast and aggressive attack. With the use of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal, the deck aims to generate mana quickly and efficiently while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Metallic Rebuke and Tormod's Crypt. By overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creatures, artifacts, and spells, this deck seeks to win the game quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on cycling through cards to fill up the graveyard and then casting Living End to return all creatures to the battlefield, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Negation and Endurance. It also aims to control the board with Shardless Agent and Subtlety, creating a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent's defenses and secure victory through a flurry of creatures hitting the battlefield at once.

This deck revolves around using counter spells and disruptive effects to control the game while setting up a powerful combo finish with Goblin Charbelcher. By utilizing cards like Flare of Denial, Disrupting Shoal, and Suppression Ray to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to buy time until it can assemble the Goblin Charbelcher combo for a quick win. The deck also includes ramp and card draw spells like Whir of Invention and Sea Gate Restoration to help find key pieces of the combo and maintain card advantage.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with flickering effects to gain value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can repeatedly blink powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to control the board and pressure your opponent. Additionally, cards like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize help disrupt graveyard strategies and control decks, allowing you to maintain a strong board presence and outpace your opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Amulet Titan combo to quickly ramp up mana and land drops, eventually leading to a win condition through cards like Primeval Titan, Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and Scapeshift. The deck focuses on assembling the pieces needed to create a powerful board state that can overwhelm the opponent with a combination of land destruction and massive damage output. By efficiently utilizing cards like Explore, Amulet of Vigor, and Gruul Turf, the deck can quickly establish a dominant position on the battlefield and secure victory.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence. The deck also utilizes cards like Psychic Frog and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to control the board and protect its combo pieces. With a mix of instant-speed spells like Ephemerate and Force of Negation, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The deck's land base includes fetch lands and a variety of color sources to ensure consistency in casting its spells.

The deck focuses on using creatures with abilities that trigger when they enter or leave the battlefield, combined with cards that allow you to exile and then return those creatures to trigger their abilities multiple times. By combining aggressive creatures with blinking effects, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also continuously generating value and tempo advantage. Through a combination of removal spells, disruption, and synergistic creature abilities, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through a combination of combat damage and powerful creature effects.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures and spells, while also controlling the board with counterspells. The goal is to fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to return them all to the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent. The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the pieces needed to cast Living End, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and card draw. The deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with a large number of powerful creatures in a single turn.
